freeze_rule: FROZEN_REFERENCE_FLIGHT_ARCHITECTURE only when architecture-level gates have sufficient evidence; until then INVESTIGATION_HYPOTHESIS

configuration.rule: the candidate is defined for the primary configuration; C1 rows that differ are carried by the cited deliverables (RVM / mass_power v2 / bus boundary) as the CONTROL_FALLBACK reference

what_this_is_not: not a frozen architecture and not FROZEN_REFERENCE_FLIGHT_ARCHITECTURE
not a selection: Pareto sets are carried, no representative point is chosen (F9-OQ-01)

not a Pareto set over the admissible compressor space: the F7 / F8 sets (and every UPSTREAM PARETO_SET row here) are Pareto within the F3 front-union subset (32 of the 48 designs passing F3's inlet-independent gates; INT-01 limitation recorded in F4 / F7)
lane interface statuses quoted from F1..F7 are the lanes' own records after the A9.7 integration pass (counterparts resolved to merged paths and record ids); F9-ID-01..08 record what F9 consumed
no Hall performance number: credible Hall set empty, P5-N2 v1 INCONCLUSIVE; withdrawn 0-D results unused
no PASS, no winner; no owner question answered
no existing module, frozen dataset, decision, CLAUDE.md or HISTORY modified; not wired into archengine

freeze_status_vocabulary.FREEZE_CANDIDATE: owner-given decision, convention, rule or allocation that can enter the architecture reference as stated; a candidate, never a frozen value (nothing is frozen by this lane)
freeze_status_vocabulary.OPEN: a value, window, set or Pareto set exists (derived / analog / parametric / allocation) but it is not yet a design value; the listed evidence moves it toward FREEZE_CANDIDATE
freeze_status_vocabulary.TBD_AFTER_EVIDENCE: no admissible value; it needs measurement, analysis or sourced data
freeze_status_vocabulary.TBD_OWNER: needs an owner decision (the existing or new owner question is cited)

evidence_class_rule: evidence_class describes what happened to the number (docs/EVIDENCE.md quantity type, plus owner-allocation and requirement-as-recorded); null for a TBD value; qualifiers go to evidence_note

value_labels.PARETO_SET: the value is a Pareto set (or a set of Pareto members' values); no member is selected
value_labels.PARAMETRIC_SENSITIVITY: computed from uncited code-default coefficients and / or parametric cases (A9.7 F3 / F4 / F7 / F8 label); never a design value, a CBE or a requirement
value_labels.ALLOCATION: owner allocation (budget), not a CBE and not a measured value
value_labels.REQUIREMENT_AS_RECORDED: RFP value as recorded from secondary sources (official RFP not in the repository; RVM requirement_frozen = false)
value_labels.WINDOW: admissible window or analog envelope, not a design point
